items.title: Axon Enterprise (AXON) Ties Its Police Tech Into One $8.8 Million City Deal
items.summary: Axon Enterprise (NasdaqGS:AXON) has secured an $8.8m, 8 year contract to supply an integrated police tech platform. The agreement consolidates body cameras, drones, license plate readers and related tools into a single Axon system for the city. The deal introduces AI assisted report drafting and live video feeds into the city's Real Time Crime Center operations.
